title: Lead, Specialist Solution Engineer Marketing Cloud
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Salesforce Public Sector Specialists Solutions Engineering team is a team of technology, industry and business process experts who are the partner for all public organizations and education institutions. We support their transformation and help them modernize their processes in order to deliver on their missions to citizens and businesses.

This position is dedicated to supporting the UK and Ireland Public Sector and Education Marketing Cloud Sales team.

Salesforce Marketing Cloud is a leader in AI driven digital marketing automation across email, mobile, social and web. Presenting to audiences ranging from operational marketing and IT teams to C-Level executives and public servants, the ideal candidate must be motivated and capable of delivering memorable presentations and demonstrations while knowledgeably supporting the discussion of our marketing solutions to all levels of detail.

About the Requirements

Primary requirements

The candidate will ideally have the following competencies and experience:

  • A proven track record of success - ideally a minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role (Solution Consultant, Consultant, Project Lead, ideally in the marketing technology area)
  • AI fluency : experience using Codex, Claude Code or any other AI tool to code / configure / craft assets is a strong plus
  • Hands on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement or Marketing Cloud Next (Certification is a plus)
  • Be able to work with an extended team to plan and implement upon a targeted engagement campaign
  • Having the curiosity and tenacity to undertake deep, relevant client discovery and to ensure that the resulting presentation and solution demonstration solves for the identified business challenges
  • Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills, comfortable presenting to teams, occasionally larger groups, CMOs and senior officers.
  • A passion for storytelling to bring customer engagements to life using impactful presentation and solution demonstration content
  • Having a results driven mentality to maximize the impact of all Marketing Cloud solution messaging in a language that resonates with the customer
  • Agility to thrive with change, and variety, often working across multiple concurrent customer engagements
  • Be an autonomous self-starter that is able to handle and prioritize tasks effectively
  • Be up to date of the latest trends in customer marketing, martech, customer experience and customer engagement
  • Have an appetite to innovate Salesforce solutions to drive improvements in both customer and colleague experience
  • Have a passion for continual personal development

Secondary requirements

It would be excellent, but not at all crucial, if the candidate has:

  • Public Sector experience (central government, healthcare, transportation, etc.) or Education experience
  • Hands on experience on Salesforce Data Cloud (Data360)
  • Relevant digital marketing qualifications or equivalent work experience with demonstrated proficiency
  • Experience with product management or implementation

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Posting Statement

title: Senior Solutions Consultant
description:
Headquarters: Remote (USA - Boston, MA)

 PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 We are seeking a technical and customer-focused Solutions Consultant to join our team . The Solutions Consultant will be responsible for understanding customer business environments, actively identifying potential roadblocks, and providing thoughtful solutions that leverage PagerDuty’s products . They will run the technical discovery process and provide guidance, relationship-building, and support throughout the sales process to ensure customer success .

 As a Solutions Consultant at PagerDuty, you’ll sit at the nexus between pre-sales, sales, and customer experience and success . You are an extraordinary partner who plays the part of consultant, technical salesperson, technical guru, product specialist, and teacher, with a committed dedication to exceptional customer service . You will build strong, significant, and compassionate relationships with internal and external partners at all levels while helping customers realize and optimize PagerDuty's capabilities .

 Key responsibilities

• Actively identify potential roadblocks and provide thoughtful, technical solutions

• Run technical discovery processes to understand customer environments and potential technical landmines

• Design integrations to provide seamless implementation with the customer's current technology stack

• Support sales cycles by handling technical questions in RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires

• Break down complex technical concepts and clearly articulate PagerDuty's business value to stakeholders from DevOps engineers up to C-level executives

• Support one of our over 375+ native integrations to help customers realize and optimize PagerDuty's capabilities

• Partner with sales, product, and cross-functional teams with a focus on growth and exceptional customer service

• Manage multiple tasks independently and collaboratively using project management and account management skills

• Come up to speed quickly, learn continuously, and apply impeccable attention to detail to all tasks

 Basic qualifications

• 5+ years of pre-sales experience

• Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in a technical field

• Ability to do basic scripting (Java, PHP, Ruby, Perl) and a fundamental knowledge of Linux

• Experience selling SaaS in a fierce environment

• Strong communication skills to build and manage relationships with new and existing clients, with a focus on growth

• Demonstrable knowledge of IT monitoring tools or IT Operations

• Excellent at multi-tasking, self-driven, and able to work both independently and with cross-functional teams

• Ability to travel to customer sites as necessary

 Preferred qualifications

• Understanding of monitoring systems such as New Relic, Nagios, Zenoss, Splunk, ServiceNow, and Zabbix

• Familiarity and knowledge of PagerDuty's space, or already being a fan of our product

• Experience in both enterprise and commercial sales

 PagerDuty is a flexible, hybrid workplace. We embrace and encourage in-person working as an integral part of our culture. Both our employees and external research tells us that co-located collaboration strengthens connections, drives innovation, and accelerates learning.

 The base salary range for this position is 144,000 - 197,200 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

 Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

 Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.
 Hesitant to apply?

 We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts !

 Where we work

 PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

 Location restrictions:
 Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia

 How we work

 Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

 People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

description:
Headquarters: Remote, Massachusetts, United States, AMER

 From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role
We’re looking to hire a Sales Director to join the Revenue Team in Boston, MA. This person will be responsible for building out our enterprise customer base. The ideal person will be a proactive and curious member of our growing Sales team, identifying new business with prospects and growth opportunities for clients. A certain level of foresight and knowledge working with intrinsic sales cycles will take this individual confidently into the future of dbt Labs.

 What You'll Do

• Own the full sales cycle from lead to ongoing utilization for enterprise prospects

• Organize POC implementations of dbt Cloud Enterprise

• Win 20 new dbt Cloud Enterprise customers per year (after ramp)

• Lead and contribute to team projects that develop our sales process

• Work with product to build and maintain the dbt Cloud enterprise roadmap

• Become an expert in SQL, dbt, and enterprise data operations

• Be an active member of the dbt open source community

 Skills We’re Looking For

• 6+ years closing experience in technology sales, with 2+ years of experience in enterprise sales.

• Ability to understand complex technical concepts and develop them into a consultative sale

• Excellent verbal, written, and in-person communication skills to engage stakeholders at all levels of an analytics organization (individual developer up to CTO)

• The diligence and organizational skills to work long, intricate sales cycles involving multiple client teams

• Ability to operate in an ambiguous and fast-paced work environment

• A passion for being an inclusive teammate and involved member of the community

• Experience with SQL or willingness to learn

 Bonus Skills​

• Prior experience in analytics, ETL, BI, and/or open-sourced software

• Knowledge of or prior experience with dbt

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

 About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

 We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

 Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

 Our Core Technologies

 Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

 What You'll Do

 • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

 • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

 • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

 • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

 • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

 • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

 • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

 • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

 • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

 • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

 • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

 What We Look For:

 • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

 • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

 • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

 • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

 • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

 • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

 • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

 • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

 Nice To Have:

 • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

 • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

 • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

 • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

 • Conversation design or UX writing experience

 What We Offer You:

 • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

 • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

 • Flexible PTO

 • Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

 • Health & wellness initiatives

title: Customer Solutions Engineer, EMEA
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Ireland

 About the Role

 Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.

 What you will do

• Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.

• Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.

• Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.

• Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.

• Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.

• Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.

• Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.

• Surface patterns across engagements to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive systemic improvement.

 Must Haves

• 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (email infrastructure, IT security/administration, engineering, or technical support) in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity

• Solid grounding in Abnormal's platform and configuration best practices, sufficient to work independently with customers without a senior technical resource in the room

• Strong triage judgment; able to recognize quickly whether a situation calls for hands-on technical guidance or a more senior technical resource

• Comfortable stepping into a customer relationship for a defined engagement and stepping back out; this is not a standing account-ownership role

• Able to manage multiple concurrent, time-bound engagements across a broad book of business rather than a fixed set of named accounts

• Excellent communication skills across technical and business stakeholders, including comfort presenting to senior customer stakeholders

 Nice to Have

• Familiarity with email authentication/delivery protocols and cloud email platforms (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace)

• Prior experience in a floating/pooled technical resource model (e.g., professional services, deployment, or solutions engineering)

• Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience

 Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

 What You Will Do

 We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice.

 If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:

• Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.

• Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.

• Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.

• Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.

• Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.

• Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.

 What You Will Bring to the Table

 We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

• 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).

• Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built.

• Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs.

• A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams.

• Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox.

• Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.

• A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.

 Bonus:

• Exposure to AI ecosystems, MCP, AI agents, or LLM tooling (helpful, not required).

• Experience in multi-product B2B SaaS, or with HR/people-data or other sensitive-data workflows.

 If you have strong experience with integrations, APIs, or platform products, even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for strong product thinkers with deep technical fluency, not perfect resumes.

 Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

 __

 The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $135,000 - $180,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

 Benefits: Lattice offers eligible Canada-based employees comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; mental health and wellness support; emergency weather support; 16 weeks of paid parental leave; flexible time off, 13 company holidays, and 3 recharge days; a monthly remote-work stipend and one-time home-office setup stipend; an RRSP contribution match of up to 3% of gross pay (maximum $2,500 CAD annually); and a $500 CAD annual Learning & Development reimbursement. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements.

 *Note on Pay Transparency:

 Lattice provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by state regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience.

 Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lattice reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

 About Lattice

 Lattice is on a mission to build cultures where employees and their companies thrive. In an age where employees have more choices than ever before, businesses that put employees first are winning – and Lattice is building the tools to empower those people-centric companies.

 Lattice is a people success platform that offers performance reviews, employee engagement surveys, real-time feedback, weekly check-ins, goal setting, and career planning in a way that allows companies to focus on employee development, growth, and engagement – yielding stronger employee retention, performance, and impact to the bottom line . Since launching in 2016, we have grown to over 5,000+ customers globally, including brands like Loom, Robinhood, and Gusto.

title: Senior Manager, Quality, Volume Tiers
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://careers.airbnb.com/life-at-airbnb/

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

 The Community You Will Join:

 The Senior Quality Lead, Volume Tiers is the single accountable leader for quality measurement, insights, and continuous improvement across Airbnb's highest-volume Community Support functions. This role owns the end-to-end quality program for:

• Global English (GE)

• Rest of World (ROW; which is comprised of 9 different languages)

• Elevated Support

 GE and ROW span across multiple service tiers: Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support (DSS), Dedicated Managed Host Support (DMHS); supported across a global partner network operating 24/7 in dozens of languages.

 The Difference You will Make:

 This is a senior leadership role operating at the intersection of strategy and execution. The Senior Quality Lead will break down silos within the Quality organization, establish a unified operating model, and leverage AI-powered tools to scale quality insights. This leader will work closely with Service Delivery, Training, Business Process Improvement, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, remediate issues, and ensure Airbnb is providing its global partner network a unified set of priorities.

 The successful candidate will establish themselves as a credible partner to stakeholders and be recognized internally as the voice of quality for the Volume Tier portfolio.

 A Typical Day:

 Strategic Leadership & Program Ownership

• Own and execute the Volume Tier quality strategy aligned to several critical priorities: breaking silos, aligning with stakeholders, defining a clear operating model, and driving measurable impact.

• Consolidate fragmented QA frameworks across GE and ROW into a unified operating model, eliminating inconsistent processes, divergent NPS detractor approaches, and incompatible quality signals.

• Represent Volume Tier quality in WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and cross-functional planning forums; bring a proactive, narrative-led perspective that gives leadership visibility before problems surface in operational reviews.

 Measurement & Quality Execution

• Oversee QA evaluation execution across all Volume Tier partner sites globally, ensuring consistent application of QA processes and frameworks.

• Lead root cause analysis on systemic failures, translating QA findings into product, process, and policy recommendations that go beyond agent-level coaching.

• Formalize Audit the Auditor as an ongoing control: define sample selection, alignment thresholds, root cause review, and evaluator-level remediation processes.

• Ensure every evaluation closes with a documented coaching action; build the tracking mechanisms to measure whether coaching is translating into performance improvement over time.

 Insights, Reporting & Stakeholder Partnership

• Establish automated KPI reporting across all Volume Tier sites, tiers, and languages, eliminating manual processes.

• Unify NPS detractor analysis across GE and ROW, ensuring global patterns surface in real time.

• Build a Partner QA Performance Scorecard, establishing clear accountability for Calibration Accuracy, Evaluation Completeness, Critical Error Detection, Coaching Effectiveness.

 AI & Technology Enablement

• Lead the deployment of AutoQA (via Observe.AI) across Volume Tiers; partner with the Platform team to ensure appropriate sequencing.

• Build and govern a clear accountability framework for AI-assisted quality tools and processes.

 People & Culture Leadership

• Lead a globally distributed team of Partner Quality Leads and Quality Insights Analysts.

• Foster a One-Quality-Team culture that eliminates the cross-team divides: shared best practices, cross-regional learning, and proactive knowledge sharing.

• Set high expectations and hold the team accountable for output quality, insight delivery, and stakeholder engagement.

• Partner closely with peers to ensure one consistent quality voice across the portfolio.

 Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of experience in Customer/Community Support, Quality Assurance, or Contact Center Operations, with direct accountability for large-scale, multilingual QA programs.

• 5+ years managing globally distributed QA teams across multiple languages, regions, and partner organizations in a 24/7 support environment.

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience, preferably in related field; MBA or Masters preferred

• Experience with QA tooling platforms, including hands-on ownership of form design, calibration management, and AutoQA deployment.

• Deep expertise in quality methodologies (COPC, AQS, Six Sigma, Lean), with a proven ability to apply them to high-volume, complex support environments.

• Demonstrated track record of leading quality transformation, consolidating fragmented programs, driving measurable improvement in NPS/CSAT, and QA calibrations.

• Experience deploying or scaling AI/ML assisted QA tools (AutoQA, predictive NPS/CSAT).

• Strong executive presence: able to influence senior stakeholders, present a unified quality narrative in leadership forums, and drive alignment across stakeholders.

• Experience managing vendor partner governance: calibration oversight, performance improvement plans, and escalation frameworks.

 Preferred

• COPC certification; Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.

• Experience with Observe.AI.

• Background in program management, change management, or organizational design within a high-growth tech environment.

• Experience working in or closely with BPO/vendor governance models at scale (1,000+ partner FTEs across multiple sites and geographies).

 Your Location:

 This position is Canada - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a province where Airbnb Canada, Inc. has a registered entity. Currently we can hire in the following provinces: Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, Alberta, and Saskatchewan. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.

 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

 We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

 We use automated tools to help our recruiting team efficiently screen a large volume of applications. All final hiring decisions are made by a human reviewer.

 This role is newly created and does not replace or backfill an existing position.

 How We'll Take Care of You:

 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

 Canada Annual Pay Range

 $160,000—$200,000 CAD

 Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

 A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: VP, Finance
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://engine.com/

 About the Role

 We're looking for a VP, Finance to lead Finance at Engine and serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and executive leadership team.

 You'll own the financial strategy and operating cadence of the company, from planning and forecasting to capital allocation, business performance, financial reporting, and long-range strategy. You'll help leadership understand what is driving the business, where we should invest, and what we need to do next. You'll also be the architect of Engine's financial story, shaping how the company is understood by its Board, investors, and partners.

 You'll build the Finance organization and infrastructure to support Engine through its next phase of growth. That means creating clarity where there is ambiguity, building scalable processes before they become bottlenecks, and using data, systems, and AI to make Finance increasingly leveraged.

 Success in this role will be measured by business impact and the results of the Finance organization.

 What You'll Do

 Strategic Financial Leadership

• Serve as the CEO's financial thought partner on growth strategy, investment priorities, resource allocation, and profitability. Drive capital allocation decisions across the executive team — where Engine invests people, capital, and resources, and where we make tradeoffs. Bring financial rigor to pricing, monetization, new products, markets, and partnerships.

 Capital Strategy & Transactions

• Own fundraising, debt and liquidity strategy, M&A, and other strategic transactions. Build investor relationships, lead the Board story on performance, and prepare Engine for future capital events — including the reporting, controls, and governance a public-ready company requires (SOX readiness, audit committee partnership, external guidance frameworks).

 Financial Planning & Business Insight

• Own the financial plan — quarterly forecasting, long-range modeling, scenario analysis, and the operating cadence across Engine. Develop a deep understanding of revenue, margins, customer economics, pricing, payment economics, and cash flow. Build the metrics and frameworks that make the business legible to leadership.

 Narrative & Communication

• Tell Engine's financial story to the Board, investors, lenders, and partners — turning complex numbers into a narrative leadership can act on and external audiences believe. Lead financial reporting and help the CEO communicate performance, outlook, risks, opportunities, and key decisions with clarity.

 Build Finance for Scale

• Build and lead a high-performance Finance team — attracting exceptional talent, modernizing through AI and automation, and establishing systems, processes, data infrastructure, and controls that scale without creating bureaucracy. Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Legal, and external advisors to ensure Engine has the financial foundation required to scale responsibly.

 What You'll Bring

 Experience and Background

• 12+ years of experience across investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate finance, FP&A, strategic finance, or a related field, with significant experience in high-growth technology.

description:
Privacy Compliance Associate - Glasgow

We are seeking a Privacy Compliance Associate to join our Data Governance & AI Non-Financial Risk team, supporting Morgan Stanley in meeting its privacy and data protection obligations. The role will work across business lines to help ensure global Data Subject Rights requests, including access and erasure requests, are managed appropriately and responded to within required timeframes.

In the Legal & Compliance division, we assist the Firm in achieving its business objectives by facilitating and overseeing the Firm's management of legal, regulatory and franchise risk. This is an Associate level position within the Privacy Non-Financial Risk (NFR) team who are part of the second line of defence, governing and overseeing data subject rights requests and privacy across the Firm.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What you'll do in the role:

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm when responding to Data Subject Rights requests, including data subject access requests (DSARs) and erasure requests, within statutory deadlines.

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm with the intake, processing, redactions and quality assurance checks of request responses.

- Support Privacy NFR with oversight activity including monitoring of dashboards and production of metrics for reporting to colleagues, partners and governance groups.

- Support Privacy NFR by providing advice and guidance on global Data Subject Rights to key stakeholders across the Firm.

- Enhance policies, procedures, processes, reporting, training and support ad-hoc projects as required.

What you'll bring to the role:

- Ability to collaborate and partner with cross-functional teams, business units and individuals at all levels.

- Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

- Proactive work ethic and team player mindset.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A passion for data protection and privacy.

- A willingness to learn and develop.

- Experience with One Trust Privacy Automation/ DSAR tool or similar is preferred.

At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.

This Role is unable to offer Sponsorship.

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren't just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you'll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Interested in flexible working opportunities? Morgan Stanley empowers employees to have greater freedom of choice through flexible working arrangements. Speak to our recruitment team to find out more.

description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Slack

Slack is your Digital HQ - bringing people, apps, customers, and AI agents together in one place. Millions of people use Slack every day to communicate, collaborate, and get work done. As work becomes increasingly distributed and AI-powered, Slack is redefining how teams operate and achieve at scale. In this AI era, Slack's mission remains making people's work lives simpler, more pleasant, and more productive.

The Team

The Slack Mobile team builds Slack's mobile experiences, from core messaging to AI and everything in between.

We operate at the intersection of product innovation, mobile platform excellence, and large-scale engineering. The features and systems we build support millions of daily users and require deep investments in performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience.

The Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to help shape the future of Slack's mobile product. As a Prototyping Engineer, you'll embed as a leader on greenfield, zero-to-one initiatives. You'll influence product and design direction through engineering work that builds and ships the first versions of newly-imagined, fully working product features. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and fellow mobile engineers to help innovate some of the biggest new product opportunities for Slack, with experiences that are intuitive, performant, and reliable for millions of users worldwide.

What You'll Do

This is a role for a self-directed, creative engineer who can operate with high velocity and strong independent judgment, combining hands-on technical leadership with broad organizational influence. We are looking for someone who can start from an ambiguous problem, no defined path, and competing priorities, and work through that to frame the problem, align stakeholders on what matters most, and move quickly from idea to working prototype to a shipped experience. You will:

  • Shape the future of Slack on mobile by leading the engineering development of experiences used by millions of users every day, spanning multiple teams and the broader organization.
  • Lead the most complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from early technical exploration through production rollout and long-term evolution.
  • Lead feature prototyping to define the mobile user experience for Slack's biggest opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to shape experiences that balance user needs, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate team through technical leadership, product reviews, and mentorship.
  • Set and evangelize best practices for mobile feature development and operational excellence across the broader engineering organization.
  • Mentor senior engineers and contribute to the growth of the broader mobile engineering community within Slack.
  • A related technical degree required.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building complex, high-craft Android applications at scale.
  • Proven track record of moving outside of organizational boundaries to start new initiatives, prototype the path to production, and reorient the organization to support the new initiative.
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, whether at a start-up, in an incubator, or on a zero-to-one team inside a larger enterprise.
  • Proven track record of leading large, ambiguous, org-spanning technical initiatives with significant business impact.
  • Deep expertise in Kotlin framework and modern Android development.
  • Strong understanding of Android architecture, application lifecycle, concurrency, networking, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence product and technical direction through expertise and collaboration, driving alignment across executive stakeholders, Engineering/Product/Design leadership, and multiple teams.
  • A bias toward ownership, execution, and continuous improvement, with the judgment to prioritize the highest-leverage work across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture patterns. Experience with Kotlin coroutines, and dependency injection frameworks (e.g. Metro, Dagger).
  • Experience leading large-scale new products, features, or product transformations spanning multiple teams or the whole org.
  • Experience using research, usability testing, data, and experimentation to ground decisions and uncover opportunities.
  • Contributions to open source projects or the Android community, or other external recognition of technical leadership.
  • Experience building collaboration, productivity, messaging, AI, or enterprise software products.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Strong product intuition and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

 Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

 We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

 One Role, Multiple Teams

 We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

 If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

 Potential team placements include:

• Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.

• Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.

• Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.

• Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.

• Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.

• International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

 About the Role

 As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

 You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

 You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

 What You Will Do

• Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.

• Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

• Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.

• Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.

• AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.

 What We Look For

• 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.

• Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

• Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

• Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.

• Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.

• Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.

 Pay Grade - I
Equity Grade - 5

 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

title: Research Data Expert
location: London, United Kingdom, New York, NY, Singapore
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.

In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain
  • Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets
  • Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation
  • Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities
  • Analyze data to identify and improve alpha
  • Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets
  • Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours
  • Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts

Qualifications

  • Strong programming skills (Python/R preferred) and proficiency in data science methodologies
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a specific data domain (e.g., alternative data, fundamentals, security reference, or economic data)
  • Proven track record of building alpha through detailed data analysis
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Undergraduate degree in a STEM field

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.  About the team

 Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.

 What you’ll do

 As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.

 Responsibilities

• Proactive Threat Hunting & Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.

• FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints.

• Threat Intelligence & Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows.

• Cross-Functional Advisories & Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security.

• Agentic Testing & Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls.

 Who you are

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.

• 5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.

• B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.

• Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.

• Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.

 Preferred qualifications

• Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).

• Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&CK.

• Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.

• Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.

• Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.

• Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).

title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Job Title: Principal Software Engineer, AI

 Location : Remote - US

 Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

 With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

 Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

 THE OPPORTUNITY

 At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.

 This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.

 On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.

• Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.

• Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

• Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.

• Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.

• Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.

 This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.

 You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.

 This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.

 THE TEAM

 The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.

 The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.

 THE SKILL SET

• Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.

• Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.

• Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.

• Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.

• A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.

• Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).

• Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.

• Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.

 BENEFITS:

 For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/

 At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

 Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page .

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

 #LI-REMOTE
 It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable. The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.

 Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

 The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.
